title: Holo-NN: Holographic Nearest Neighbor Search via Compressive Sensing
abstract: arXiv:2610.33224v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In the age of AI, privacy-preserving approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search over high-dimensional embeddings has emerged as a critical yet frustratingly challenging domain, dominated by tradeoffs between speed, privacy, and accuracy. Traditional tree and graph-based indexing structures (e.g., HNSW, ScaNN) rely fundamentally on non-linear operations that are computationally intractable under Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) or blind server-side constraints.   In this paper, we introduce Holo-NN (Holographic Nearest Neighbor Search), an algebraic framework that replaces data-dependent branching with a single linear projection. Our key observation is that while distances across a database are dense, neighborhood membership is inherently sparse: only a handful of points ever lie close to a query. By pairing locality-preserving feature transforms with Compressive Sensing, Holo-NN folds the entire database offline into a compact hologra

translated_title: Holo-NN：基于压缩感知的全息最近邻搜索
translated_abstract: 在人工智能时代，对高维嵌入向量进行隐私保护的近似最近邻（ANN）搜索已成为一个至关重要却又极具挑战性的领域，其核心难题在于速度、隐私和准确性之间的权衡。传统的基于树和图的索引结构（如HNSW、ScaNN）从根本上依赖于非线性运算，而这些运算在全同态加密（FHE）或盲服务器端约束下是难以高效计算的。本文提出了Holo-NN（全息最近邻搜索），这是一个用单一线性投影取代数据依赖分支的代数框架。我们的关键观察是：虽然数据库中各点之间的距离分布是稠密的，但邻域成员关系在本质上是稀疏的——只有极少数点会靠近某个查询点。通过将保局特征变换与压缩感知相结合，Holo-NN在离线阶段将整个数据库折叠为一个紧凑的全息（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出Holo-NN代数框架，利用压缩感知与保局特征变换，以单一线性投影取代传统索引中数据依赖的非线性分支运算，从而在隐私保护约束（如全同态加密）下实现高效的高维近似最近邻搜索。
en_tdlr: Holo-NN introduces an algebraic framework that replaces data-dependent branching with a single linear projection by pairing locality-preserving feature transforms with compressive sensing, enabling efficient privacy-preserving approximate nearest neighbor search under FHE constraints.
